blocks.head: alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device and holds key
alt The user is near the device
alt The user holds key and the device exists
alt The user holds key and the device exists
alt The user is away and the device exists
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : true , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : OldKey , ..) > $ UserX 'setKey' deviceB | (Key) 
= < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendBindingKey' cloudA | (Key) .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : OldKey , ..) , ...) > $ deviceB 'sendBindingKey' cloudA | (Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , ..) , ...) > .

eq < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'retrieveKey' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : OldKey , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , ..) , 'owner' : nils , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , ..) , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , ..) , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : '' , ..) , 'owner' : nils , ...) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : false , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > .

=> ep: ev2(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > .
